title: Purview: Endpoint DLP policy sync status within 30 minutes
summary: Microsoft 365 Roadmap item 558682 is 'Rolling out' (GA November 2026, updated 26 November): the Purview portal should show Endpoint DLP policy sync status within 30 minutes instead of the previous two-hour target. The change is about how quickly the portal reports sync status for onboarded devices; the roadmap does not say that policy enforcement itself gets faster.
why: Shorter feedback makes it practical to confirm a new or changed endpoint DLP rule in the same change window instead of the next day.
todo: After rollout, time a test policy change on a pilot device and record how long sync status takes to update.
Do not shorten change windows on the assumption that enforcement is faster; verify on the device.
effective_note: Roadmap 558682, Rolling out, GA November CY2026. Not verified in a tenant.

primary.title: Microsoft 365 Roadmap 558682: Endpoint DLP policy sync status SLA 2 hours to 30 minutes
